mixins.description: All / deep mixins of this type

annotations.description:
All annotations of this type; note it includes annotations of elements like fields, methods, constants or
inner types

refs.description: All types referred to by this type in its fields or methods

calcFields.description: All types that calc fields explicitly defined in this type depend on

periodicCalcs.description: Will have entry for `PeriodicCalcState` type if type has any calc field that specifies a fixed period

scheduledCalcs.description: Will have entry for `PeriodicCalcState` type if type has any calc field that specifies a fixed schedule

fkeys.description: All types referenced by fkey fields defined in this type

hierDenorms.description: Types that have this HierarchyDenorm type as a target

secondaryDs.description: Will have entry for `EtlCoordinator` type if type specifies an `@db(secondaryDatastore)`

domainDs.description: Will have entry for `Db.Domain` type if type specifies an `@db(domain)`

nonDefaultDs.description: Will have entry for `Datastore` type if type specifies an `@db(datastore)` and it isn't "sql" or "kv"

externalDs.description: Will have entry for `SqlSourceSystem` type if type mixes `External`

metadata.description:
All declared references to non-type metadata instances in the type. Stored as map from Type name to all keys of the
dependent metadata for that type [as {@link Metadata} is a {@link WithKey}] e.g. {ImplLanguage.Runtime: ["py-data-science"]}.
Skip for backward deps computation because it does not refer to Type -> Type deps but Type -> Metadata fwd
deps, and thus, Metadata -> Type bwd deps. Therefore, it does not make sense to ask for the `metadata` bwd
deps of a Type - we would instead use this field to find the bwd deps of a metadata instance, which would be
a collection of types.

pkgName.description: The name of the package this type meta is declared in

referenceTypeRelations.description: A Map of the the fkey references to the type of the valuetype of the reference relation

validRuntimeSources.description: map of runtime to whether source code is valid or not.

issues.description: any MetadataIssues generated while building dependencies.

javaIfaceClassName.description:
Java interface class name from C3 Server jar that can be used to represent instances of this C3 type. These are
typically core platform types as well as select `duck type`s specifically designed to minimize need for Java code
generation and compilation as part of C3 Application Package

If this type is more complex and existing Java class can not be used to represent it's instances then #javaImpl
and #javaSubtypeImpl will contain generated java source code for type instance and subtype respectively

javaImpl.description:
Generated java source for instance class for this C3 type

@see javaImplClassName

javaSubtypeImpl.description:
Generated java source for subtype class for this C3 type

@see javaImplClassName

dts.description: Generated d.ts API source for this type

pyi.description: Generated pyi API source for this type

docText.description: Documentation comment content with all formatting removed.

jsonSchema.description: Generated JSON schema for this type

outerTypes.description: All outer Types of this type, if this type is inner type.

referencesTypesys.description:
Subset of T=(Type, TypeMeta) if this type holds a direct reference to any elements in T and this type is a
Metadata, Config, or Cached. Used for evicting instances of this type e.g. SourceCollection#source

cacheDependencies.description: All types that this type declared is dependent on

bundlerTsDecl.description:
Generated TypeScript declaration API source for consumption by ui bundler code, in particular
{@link UiSdlMetadataLoader#produceTsDeclNpmModule}.

title:
Validates a Canonical type and also produces any necessary generated artifacts like identity transform in case of
entity Canonicals.
name: Canonical.Deps
